run_fastapi_app: run the FastAPI app that serves the AutoTrain UI, API routes, and static files
build_fastapi_app_with_oauth: build a FastAPI app that conditionally attaches OAuth when SPACE_ID environment variable is set
create_root_redirect_route: create a GET route that redirects the root path to the UI endpoint preserving query parameters
mount_static_files: mount a static files directory to serve AutoTrain frontend assets at the /static path
include_api_and_ui_routers: include the UI router at /ui and API router at /api in the FastAPI application
